name: mind-diary
description: Connect Mind Diary and work with your private, revisioned knowledge spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Browse and update your revisioned Minds.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Mind Diary with OAuth. Browse, search, fetch, validate, export, and safely commit Markdown Memories in the Minds you can access. Every write preserves immutable history and uses optimistic concurrency.
defaultPrompt: Show the Minds I can access
Search one Mind for a Memory
